notes: A branded Auth0-style error page with a dark header holding a clipped Third Bridge logo, 'thirdbridge' and 'Oops!, something went wrong'. The gray body says 'Callback URL mismatch. The provided redirect_uri is not in the list of allowed callback URLs' and points the developer to an Application Settings page. A footer offers a 'See details for this error' link and Support links (Get Help and a no-reply email address). The message is aimed at the app developer rather than the end user, and the capture client's redirect URI was rejected.
